title: Willow review 2026: AI voice dictation, pricing and alternatives
excerpt: Willow review: what the AI dictation app does, its new Knowledge feature, pricing from $12 a month, privacy terms and how it compares with Wispr Flow and Aqua.
content:
Willow is an AI voice dictation app for Mac, Windows and iPhone: you hold a hotkey, talk, and it types cleaned-up text into whatever app your cursor is in. It suits founders, developers and anyone who writes a lot of email, Slack and AI prompts. Our verdict: a polished dictation tool with strong privacy defaults, priced level with Wispr Flow, but with no Android app and pricier than Aqua Voice or Superwhisper. Its newest feature, Willow Knowledge, launched on Product Hunt on 6 October 2026.

Key takeaways

  • What's new: Willow Knowledge imports your writing style and personal context from ChatGPT, Claude or Gemini, so Willow's Scribe feature drafts text that sounds like you.
  • Pricing: a free plan with unlimited dictation on Willow's smaller model; Pro costs $15 a month ($12 billed yearly); Business costs $35 a month ($28 yearly).
  • Privacy: Private Mode is on by default and keeps transcripts and audio on your device. Sharing anonymised text for model training is opt-in.
  • Gaps: no Android app, no public changelog, and the full SOC 2 report is only available under NDA.

What Willow does

Willow works as a system-wide dictation layer. According to Willow's website, you put your cursor in any text field (Gmail, Slack, Notion, Cursor, iMessage), hold a hotkey and speak. It then inserts formatted text with filler words removed and punctuation fixed. Willow says text appears in as little as 200 milliseconds and claims it is three times more accurate than built-in dictation. Those are the company's own figures; we have not seen independent benchmarks.

The company is Willow, Inc., a Y Combinator-backed startup. TechCrunch reported in November 2025 that founders Allan Guo and Lawrence Liu, both Stanford dropouts, had raised $4.5 million from Box Group, Y Combinator, Burst Capital and angel investors including HubSpot's Dharmesh Shah and Reddit co-founder Alexis Ohanian. The same report named Uber, Heidi Health and Zego as enterprise customers.

Willow has shipped steadily. Its Product Hunt page lists launches for the iOS keyboard (November 2025), Windows (January 2026), developers (February), teams (March), Scribe (May) and the Frontier Pro dictation model (July), before Knowledge in October.

The news hook: Willow Knowledge

Knowledge is the October 2026 launch. Willow's launch listing says it lets you bring your writing style and personal context into Willow from ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini or another assistant. In the launch discussion, maker Sharath Kuruganty explained how it works: you copy a prompt Willow gives you into your usual AI chatbot, then paste its answer back into Willow. You can then set separate preferences for contexts such as email or Slack. Co-founder Allan Guo added that it helps Willow learn your style, preferences and facts about you, and that it matters most with Scribe.

That design is worth noting. Willow doesn't connect to your ChatGPT or Claude account. It relies on a summary that you generate and paste in yourself, so you can read exactly what you hand over before you share it.

Key features

  • Dictation in any app. One hotkey on Mac and Windows, and a custom keyboard on iPhone. TechCrunch noted that the iOS keyboard keeps a full layout for manual edits.
  • Scribe. Rather than dictating word for word, you describe what you want to say, and Scribe writes it in your style. According to Willow's help centre, it can draft from scratch, reply to on-screen content, or edit highlighted text by voice. The default shortcut is Function + Control.
  • Style matching. Separate tone presets for casual messaging, work chat, email and notes, according to the personalisation guide.
  • Dictionary and shortcuts. An auto-learning dictionary for names and jargon, plus saved snippets you can insert by voice.
  • Languages and modes. The website lists 100+ languages with switching between them, a whisper mode and an offline mode.
  • Developer use. Willow's developer page pitches dictation for Cursor, Claude Code and Codex prompts, PR descriptions and tickets.

Pricing

Prices below are from Willow's pricing page, checked on 6 October 2026, in US dollars.

PlanMonthly billingAnnual billingWhat you get
Free$0$0Unlimited dictation on the smaller Frontier Mini model, limited personalisation, 20 Scribe uses a week. No card needed.
Pro$15/month$12/monthUnlimited Frontier Pro model, priority processing, writing-style memory, unlimited Scribe, longer dictation.
Business$35/month$28/monthEverything in Pro plus enforced privacy mode (zero data retention), SOC 2 Type II, HIPAA enforcement, admin and team controls.
EnterpriseCustomCustomInvoice/PO billing, SSO/SAML, MSA and DPA, usage dashboards, API access, dedicated support.

Annual billing saves 20%. Willow's help centre also offers 30% off Pro to verified students, educators, non-profit staff and military personnel, by emailing support with proof of status. Cancellation takes effect at the end of the billing period, according to the subscription guide. Neither the guide nor the terms describe a refund policy.

Willow vs alternatives

Each competitor's figures come from its own pricing page, checked on 6 October 2026.

ToolCheapest paid planFree tierPlatformsNotable
Willow$15/month ($12 yearly)Unlimited on smaller modelMac, Windows, iPhoneScribe and Knowledge; Private Mode by default
Wispr Flow$15/user/month ($12 yearly)2,000 words/week desktop, 1,000 mobileMac, Windows, iOS, AndroidSOC 2 Type II and ISO 27001; HIPAA with signed BAA

Superwhisper$8.49/month ($84.99/year, $249.99 lifetime)Unlimited with local modelsMac, Windows, iPhone, AndroidFree tier keeps dictation on-device; bring-your-own API keys on Pro

On price alone, Willow matches Wispr Flow and costs more than Aqua Voice and Superwhisper. Its free plan is generous by comparison, with unlimited dictation where Wispr Flow and Aqua cap words. If you're on Android, Wispr Flow and Superwhisper support it and Willow doesn't. If you want dictation that never leaves your laptop, Superwhisper's local models are the clearer choice.

What Product Hunt users said

Willow has an average of 4.9 out of 5 from 11 reviews on its Product Hunt reviews page. That is Product Hunt users' rating, not ours. Most reviewers praised accuracy and speed. One, Paul Sussman, said it saves him about two hours a day. The complaints were specific:

  • Martijn van Noordennen reported that the fast mode sometimes turned non-English speech into English.
  • Paul Sussman mentioned occasional slow responses, with the app warning that processing was taking longer than usual.
  • Christopher Sands, who gave 4 out of 5, wanted a way to turn off inactivity notifications.
  • One reviewer said the free tier's weekly word cap held back heavy users. Willow's current pricing page lists unlimited dictation on the free Frontier Mini model, so that limit appears to have changed.

On the Knowledge launch itself, Sara Ford asked whether it works like agent skills for Willow. Suryansh Tiwari said earlier Scribe drafts sometimes missed his context and he hoped Knowledge would fix that. When we checked, the launch had about 110 upvotes and was eighth for the day.

Privacy and data

Privacy is a strength. Willow's data protection article says Private Mode is on by default. In that mode, transcripts and audio stay on your device and aren't stored on Willow's servers, so switching devices means losing your transcript history. Sharing anonymised text through "Help Willow Improve" is opt-in, and no audio is included.

The privacy policy, updated 5 August 2026, adds three points:

  • Context awareness can read the active window when you enable it.
  • Google data, such as calendar and contacts, is read-only and is never used for training.
  • Service providers are bound by zero-retention and no-training controls. The policy doesn't name those AI providers or say where data is processed.

Willow's compliance page lists SOC 2 Type II and HIPAA support, with the reports available through its trust centre under NDA. Only Business and Enterprise enforce zero data retention for a whole team.

The terms of service are dated 30 April 2025, older than several features they now cover. They set California law, binding arbitration with a class-action waiver, and a liability cap of the greater of 12 months' fees or $100. They also say you should check AI output before relying on it.

Who should use it (and who shouldn't)

Good fit:

  • People on Mac, Windows or iPhone who write a lot of short messages and AI prompts.
  • Anyone who wants a capable free tier before paying.
  • Teams that need SOC 2 and HIPAA paperwork from a vendor with named enterprise customers.
  • Indian founders working across languages. Willow lists 100+ languages, but check how well yours works on the free plan first, given the language-switching complaint above.

Poor fit:

  • Android users.
  • Anyone who needs fully offline, open-model dictation (Superwhisper's free tier fits better).
  • Budget buyers: Aqua Voice's Pro plan is $5 a month cheaper.

If you're tracking new tools, our launches page lists Product Hunt launches as they happen, and the news section covers AI product moves.

How we scored it

We have not used it ourselves; this review is based on the vendor's documentation, pricing and terms, and public user feedback, checked on 6 October 2026.

CriterionScore (1–5)Why
Features vs alternatives4Scribe, Knowledge, style presets and 100+ languages match or exceed rivals; no Android app.
Pricing and value3A strong free tier, but Pro at $15 costs the same as Wispr Flow and more than Aqua Voice ($10) and Superwhisper ($8.49).
Ease of getting started4Free plan with no card, setup guides for Mac, Windows and iOS, and one hotkey to learn.
Privacy and data terms4On-device Private Mode by default and opt-in training; AI providers aren't named and terms date from April 2025.
Maturity and support4Funded team, named enterprise customers and a detailed help centre; no public changelog.
Overall3.8Average of the five scores.

FAQ

Is Willow free?

Yes. The free plan gives unlimited dictation on Willow's smaller Frontier Mini model and 20 Scribe uses a week. Pro unlocks the stronger Frontier Pro model and unlimited Scribe.

Is there a Willow coupon or discount?

There's no public coupon code as of 6 October 2026. Willow offers 20% off for annual billing and 30% off Pro for verified students, educators, non-profit staff and military members. You claim it by emailing support with proof of status.

Does Willow work on Android?

Not as of 6 October 2026. Willow lists Mac, Windows and iPhone. Wispr Flow and Superwhisper both support Android.

Does Willow store my voice recordings?

Not in the default Private Mode, which keeps audio and transcripts on your device. Anonymised text is shared only if you opt in to "Help Willow Improve".

What is Willow Knowledge?

It's a feature launched on 6 October 2026. It imports a summary of your writing style and personal context, which you generate in ChatGPT, Claude or Gemini and paste into Willow, so Scribe's drafts sound more like you.
